Dockle alert: CIS-DI-0007 FATAL: Always combine 'apt-get update' with 'apt-get install|upgrade' : /bin/sh -c apt-get update
documented design difference (a candidate cause, not a verdict): Dockle splits a command on && only and matches any two of the tokens apt-get, apt and update in a segment, so mentions in echo, in arguments or after a semicolon count.
